Always the same answer, so it cannot be used to find out who has an account.

Bounds.title: Bounds
Bounds.description: None means unknown or unbounded, never zero.

CuisinePolicy.title: CuisinePolicy
CuisinePolicy.description: Provisional; the shared team document uses different names for the last two.

FlavorTag.title: FlavorTag
FlavorTag.description: Closed vocabulary; the craving pipeline maps each tag to ingredient words.

HealthCondition.title: HealthCondition
HealthCondition.description: The three conditions in GC1 scope (ARCHITECTURE.md section 1).

IngredientSwap.title: IngredientSwap
IngredientSwap.description: An excluded ingredient the dish uses, and what to cook with instead.

MealEnergyRange.title: MealEnergyRange
MealEnergyRange.description: What share of the day's calories a meal should provide, e.g. lunch 30% to 40%.

NutrientVector.title: NutrientVector
NutrientVector.description:
Nutrient amounts for one basis quantity, in canonical units.

Every field is optional because sources differ: None means UNKNOWN and is never
treated as zero (ARCHITECTURE.md section 3). Food.com sugar is always None (ADR 0001).

NutritionSource.title: NutritionSource
NutritionSource.description: Where a nutrient value came from (ADR 0003 D1). A dish keeps its own source.

PortionPreset.title: PortionPreset
PortionPreset.description: Curated whole-meal portion configurations (ADR 0002 D2), not proportional scaling.

ReplacementOption.title: ReplacementOption
ReplacementOption.description: One eligible meal for a saved slot, at its STANDARD portion, before the CSP runs.

ReplacementOptionsRequest.title: ReplacementOptionsRequest
ReplacementOptionsRequest.description: Optional words for what the user would like instead ("something spicy, no rice").

SafetyVerification.title: SafetyVerification
SafetyVerification.description: Attached to every pipeline result while the stand-in KB is in use.

Sex.title: Sex
Sex.description: Only the values needed by the resting-energy estimator.

SwapProof.title: SwapProof
SwapProof.description: What to store on the substitution: the decision and its certificate binding.
